jobs.occupation: AI Solution Architect – AI & Automation platform (m/f/d) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAbout us:Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.Today technology is driving the world. We build digital agents and we engineer the future of smart wholesale by delivering pragmatic, secure, maintainable, and observable AI powered solutions, that drive business value. Your work will have an impact on how METRO works in the age of AI. solutions;- Design the integration of the new AI solutions into our current enterprise application landscape;- Create comparative analysis and technical recommendations across multiple AI solutions (agents orchestrators, open LLMs, computer vision solutions);- Define technical standards, frameworks, and best practices for AI and ML systems;- Advising business stakeholders on technical vision and strategy;- You are inspiring and coaching the development teams to use the power of Google Cloud AI services/products;- Being constantly on the lookout for new inspiration to improve the architecture in and beyond your area of responsibility.QualificationsRequired key competencies and qualifications:- Experience in architecting AI-powered products based on Google Cloud Platform;- Experience in an architect role, especially in Cloud environments;- Very good understanding of a diverse technology stack, and architectural approaches, to recommend appropriate software architecture and solutions to complex business problems;- You can translate the impact of architecture and design choices on non-functional requirements like scalability, performance, availability and security, in the context of AI-powered solutions;- You can discuss architecture principles for agent and multi-agents systems;- Being able to translate business requirements into technical frameworks;- A wide range of expertise that includes modern operations approaches (CI/CD pipelines, logging & monitoring) in the context of AI-powered solutions (i.e. chats, agents, ML models, computer vision models);- Inspirational attitude towards the usage of AI solutions, keen on redefining how METRO works in the age of AI;- Collaborative leader who can bridge technical, business and governance teams.- Very good fluency in English (written and verbal).Additional InformationWhat we offer at METRO.digital?- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.At METRO.digital, we promote work-life jobs.occupation: Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin - Steuerrecht)
jobs.description: Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business. At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. Behind our world-leading operations stands a strong commitment to governance, compliance, and risk management. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment. Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)   Why experienced insurance professionals join this role* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market. You'll make an impact by:* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions. What You Will Do:Insurance Tax & Compliance* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization.  Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. Who You AreYou are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. What We Offer* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.) Why DHL Group?At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance. Your benefits * Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more! About DHL GroupDHL Group is the world’s leading logistics company, connecting people and businesses in more than 220 countries and territories through a comprehensive portfolio of logistics, e-commerce, parcel, express, freight forwarding, and supply chain management services.With approximately 580,000 employees worldwide, DHL Group operates one of the largest global logistics networks.Our purpose is simple: Connecting People. Improving Lives. Apply now with your complete documents, stating your salary expectations, using the application button. For further information, please visit careers.dhl.com. For initial personal contact and any questions, please contact Sven Rötzel at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or 0228-189-52128. We look forward to receiving your application*.CONNECTING PEOPLE. IMPROVING LIVES. *At DHL Group, applications from all individuals are welcome, regardless of age, gender, origin, religion or physical attributes.

The TRR404 “Next Generation Electronics With Active Devices in Three Dimensions [Active-3D]” is a Collaborative Research Center/Transregio between TUD Dresden University of Technology and Rheinisch-Westfälische Technische Hochschule Aachen (RWTH Aachen) funded by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft. The TRR aims at exploring a completely new approach for microelectronics technology and therefore teams up materialists, electrical engineers, and computer scientists of TUD, RWTH Aachen and Gesellschaft für Angewandte Mikro- und Optoelektronik mbH (AMO) in Aachen, Forschungszentrum Jülich (FZJ), Max Planck Institute of Microstructure Physics Halle (MPI-MSP), Nanoelectronic Materials Laboratory gGmbH (NaMLab) in Dresden, Ruhr-Universität Bochum (RUB).For the initial funding phase (April 2025 – December 2028), the TRR404 offers several PhD and Postdoc positions with starting dates from April 1, 2025 onwards. All vacancies can be found here: https://cfaed.tu-dresden.de/trr-vacancies (https://cfaed.tu-dresden.de/trr-vacancies) .For TUD diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.At TUD the TRR404 offers, subject to the availability of resources, a full-time position asResearch Associate (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting January 1, 2027. The position is limited to 24 months with the option of extension subject to further projects. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification. Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application.Position#5:              TRR404-TUD-B06Project:                     B06 System Models, Architectures, and Application Mapping Tools Project Leader:    Prof. Jeronimo Castrillon (Chair of Compiler Construction)Tasks:The PhD student will be mostly in charge of modeling operations of emerging computing architectures, designing compiler abstractions, and working towards a programming framework for the 3D systems.Requirements: - excellent university degree (Master/ diploma or equivalent) in computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering or a relevant area- sound knowledge in C/C++ software development, experience in compilers (LLVM, MLIR) and automatic code optimization, knowledgeable in computer architecture- above-average degree achieved in short study period- willingness and ability to think beyond the boundaries of your field, to act in an international and diverse environment and to live an open and constructive communication- strong analytic and problem-solving skills, creativity- an independent, target- and solution-driven work attitude- fluency in English, knowledge of German would be a plusWe offer:A varied and challenging research task, embedded in a friendly, inclusive and supportive team of the TRR’s Principal Investigators (i.e., project leaders and supervisors). We maintain an open and cooperative work attitude with maximum personal responsibility, mutual support with a solution-oriented approach, and flexible working hours where possible. As a PhD student you will be integrated in the TRR’s Graduate School as well as becoming a member of the TUD’ Graduate Academy. Both will offer tailored educational programs and individual supervision agreements.In addition, TUD offers: - employment in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement for the public service of the Länder (TV-L)- an individual assignment of the collective agreement experience level taking into account your previous professional experience- 30 days annual vacation (based on a 5-day workweek) and annual bonus payment (restrictions apply)- additional pension scheme (VBL)- very good accessibility by public transport- car parking facilities- state-of-the-art buildings with labs equipped to a high technical standard- a wide range of offers for health promotion and for the compatibility of family and career- numerous opportunities for further training, including language courses, IT courses and other coursesTUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents including a motivation letter, CV, copy of degree certificate, transcript of grades (i.e., the official list of coursework including your grades) and proof of English language skills, by October 30, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de by sending it as a single pdf file quoting the reference number TRR404-TUD-B06 in the subject header to jeronimo.castrillon@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:jeronimo.castrillon@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Chair of Compiler Construction, Prof. Jerónimo Castrillón, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: ProgrammierenErweiterte Kenntnisse: Elektrotechnik, Mathematik, Informatik
